active_checks.source: Create a realistic barren lunar surface composition, viewed from a low camera roughly 1.6 m above the local ground. Include a gently undulating foreground of gray regolith, at least three shallow craters with raised irregular rims, scattered small stones and several larger angular rocks, and low distant ridges forming a layered horizon. Build the foreground and midground as genuine terrain geometry, not an image plane or a flat floor covered only by a normal map. Let rock sizes range approximately from 0.05 m pebbles to 1 m boulders, with partial burial and varied orientations. Use fine regolith detail without repeating an obvious tiling pattern across the image. Light the scene with a single dominant low-angle sun so that rocks and crater rims cast long coherent shadows against a nearly black sky. Place a small partially illuminated blue Earth above the distant horizon; keep it clearly separate from the terrain and much smaller in the image than the foreground landforms. Use an exposed terrain area of at least 80 by 80 metres so a second camera 2 m to the side reveals consistent nearby parallax. No astronaut, lander, labels, camera crosshairs, animation or orbital calculation is needed.

## 当前复评口径：v8 / Strict fidelity review

仅复评原作品，未改动原生成题面。逐题原图/文本特征；主视图必查，跨视图项必须核对所有公开原图和候选双视图。
每项列出达成、差异和严重度后评0–4级；主要缺陷最多2级，主体错误/缺失0级，不能因制作精致掩盖不忠于参考。
保持原总权重及自动/物理测量：Brief VLM60/测量30/物理10；Edit 数值20/目标30/保持20/物理10/VLM20；Reference 图像50/定位20/物理10/VLM20。
定位沿用原冻结参考框及公式，重新独立识别候选框。禁止任意配准。未展示仅扣对应项；技术失败不补零。
机器草案和裁判尚待人工校准，不声称人工认证。详见 harness/vlm_spec.json。
